scenarios.notes: c1_minimal: smallest legal model: C=1, M=2, d=1, K=1, T=3, no NaN
c1_T1: T=1: the backward loop body never executes
c2_diag_d1: C=2, all d_c=1 (gmm_pdf_fast scalar-D branch), T=2
c2_diag_d1_nan: all d_c=1 with scattered NaN: the only way to hit the historical section-0.4.9 gmm_pdf_fast bug (now fixed in P0b)
c3_het_diag: heterogeneous C=3 baseline, diag covariance; also the dense contrast for SED diagnostics
c3_het_full: heterogeneous C=3, all d_c=3, full covariance, no NaN
c3_het_full_nan: full covariance with scattered NaN plus one fully-missing timestep in one channel (exercises the section-3bis.2 gmm_pdf.m fix)
c3_nan_timestep: one whole timestep missing in exactly one channel (others observed at that t)
c3_channel_all_nan: one entire channel is NaN for every t: that channel's likelihood factor must equal 1 throughout

c3_sparse_l2r: decoupled (theta=I), strictly left-to-right transitions, pi0 one-hot at state 1: state 3 of every channel has alpha==0 at t=2 unless pi0_reg is disabled. Requires pi0_reg=0 (recorded per-file, both variants) to actually reach the exact-zero path -- section-0.3.3(4). Exercises the P0b safe-division fix.
c3_coupling_degenerate: coupling strongly diagonal-dominant (0.999 self / 0.0005 cross per column): near-decoupled regime, section-0.3.3(3)
c3_coupling_zero_row: coupling row 1 near-zero (sum <= 1e-10): triggers flag_nan and the beta(isnan)=b guard

c3_lowmass_diag: one (state,component) has near-zero posterior responsibility throughout (diag covariance). The MATLAB weight+1 fallback this axis originally targeted is em_lsim M-step-only and is covered by the future EM-trace/M-step fixtures (P4), not here; this fixture instead tests the forward-backward kernel's numerical behaviour with a near-zero-mass state as input.
c3_lowmass_full: same as c3_lowmass_diag but full covariance

c3_sigma_repair_1eig: one state's full covariance is near-singular (smallest eigenvalue ~1e-8, still PD -- mvnpdf errors on a genuinely indefinite input, so the exact eig<=0 M-step repair threshold of section-0.4.10 cannot be reproduced as a forward-backward INPUT and is deferred to P4). Tests gmm_pdf numerical robustness near singularity.
c3_sigma_repair_2eig: as c3_sigma_repair_1eig, but two of the three eigenvalues of one state's covariance are tiny
c5_dense_diag: C=5, homogeneous shapes, T=50, dense coupling and transitions
c5_mixed_d: C=5, heterogeneous M_c in 2..6, mixed d_c including 1, 2 and 5
c5_K_mixed: C=5, mixed num_gmm_component including 1, 2 and 3
c3_T500_diag: long sequence, T=500, to check the recursion stays numerically flat rather than compounding

c3_trials_unequal: 3 trials of unequal length (T=20,35,50), same model, independent forward-backward calls. The em_lsim-specific multi-trial bookkeeping (trail_time_index, L_T_1, gamma_P0 averaging) has no forward-backward analogue and is exercised separately by the EM-trace fixture (P4).
c3_fast_diag: diag covariance; documented primarily as a fast-variant fixture (svi_eps guard, w_opt exponent), also exported under sed
c3_fast_full: full covariance; documented primarily as a fast-variant fixture, also exported under sed
c3_fast_nan: scattered NaN; documented primarily as a fast-variant fixture -- fast's NaN guard is unconditional (no flag_nan gate), unlike sed's, also exported under sed

c3_coupling_zero_row_exact: coupling row 1 EXACTLY zero (sum(theta(1,:)) == 0): POISE's theta_out == 0 branch, where the backward message is the bare observation term. P12 addition, exported for the poise variants only -- c3_coupling_zero_row's 1e-12 row only approaches this.
